name: svg-french-press-claude-opus-5.5-v2-s3-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 1420" width="900" height="1420" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="steel" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a9097"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#eef1f4"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#7b8188"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#cfe6f2" stop-opacity=".7"/><stop offset=".3" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity=".5"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#a9cbe0" stop-opacity=".7"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="black" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#222"/><stop offset=".4" stop-color="#666"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1a1a1a"/></linearGradient>
  <pattern id="mesh" width="4" height="4" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L4 4M4 0L0 4" stroke="#555" stroke-width=".5"/></pattern>
  <marker id="dot" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="3" refY="3"><circle cx="3" cy="3" r="2" fill="#333"/></marker>
</defs>
<rect width="900" height="1420" fill="#fbfaf7"/>
<text x="450" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#222">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>
<text x="450" y="62" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#555">Standard three-piece plunger filter (cross plate · mesh screen · spiral plate)</text>

<!-- center axis -->
<line x1="400" y1="80" x2="400" y2="1390" stroke="#c33" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="14 4 3 4"/>

<!-- 1 knob -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <path d="M380 118 Q378 88 400 84 Q422 88 420 118 Z" fill="url(#black)"/>
  <rect x="376" y="116" width="48" height="10" rx="3" fill="url(#black)"/>
</g>
<!-- 2 rod -->
<g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.2">
  <rect x="396" y="150" width="8" height="250" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <rect x="393" y="150" width="14" height="12" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <g stroke="#555" stroke-width="1"><path d="M396 372l8 3M396 378l8 3M396 384l8 3M396 390l8 3M396 396l8 3"/></g>
</g>

<!-- 3 lid -->
<g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5">
  <path d="M300 450 L300 470 A100 22 0 0 0 500 470 L500 450 Z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="450" rx="100" ry="22" fill="#e6e9ec"/>
  <path d="M322 452 A78 16 0 0 1 478 452" fill="none" stroke="#888"/>
  <path d="M320 470 L320 492 A80 16 0 0 0 480 492 L480 470" fill="#b8bec4" stroke="#555"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="444" rx="16" ry="5" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="444" rx="5" ry="2" fill="#333"/>
  <path d="M470 458 L494 452 L492 462 L468 466 Z" fill="#555" stroke="none"/>
</g>

<g transform="translate(0,-158)"><!-- 6 cross plate -->
<g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.3">
  <path d="M296 718 v6 A104 23 0 0 0 504 724 v-6" fill="#9aa0a6"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="718" rx="104" ry="23" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <g fill="#fbfaf7" stroke="#666">
    <path d="M308 718 A92 20 0 0 1 390 698.5 L390 714 Z"/>
    <path d="M410 698.5 A92 20 0 0 1 492 718 L410 714 Z"/>
    <path d="M308 718 A92 20 0 0 0 390 737.5 L390 722 Z"/>
    <path d="M410 737.5 A92 20 0 0 0 492 718 L410 722 Z"/>
  </g>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="718" rx="12" ry="4" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="718" rx="4" ry="1.5" fill="#222"/>
</g>
</g>
<!-- 5 mesh -->
<g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.3">
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="640" rx="110" ry="25" fill="url(#mesh)"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="640" rx="110" ry="25" fill="none" stroke-width="3" stroke="#777"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="640" rx="7" ry="2.5" fill="#fbfaf7"/>
</g>
<g transform="translate(0,158)"><!-- 4 spiral plate -->
<g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.3">
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="560" rx="112" ry="26" fill="none" stroke="#666" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="560" rx="104" ry="23" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <path d="M400 560 m-10 0 a10 3 0 1 1 20 0 a20 5 0 1 1 -40 0 a32 8 0 1 1 64 0 a46 11 0 1 1 -92 0 a62 14 0 1 1 124 0 a78 17 0 1 1 -156 0" fill="none" stroke="#555"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="560" rx="5" ry="2" fill="#222"/>
  <path d="M296 560 v5 A104 23 0 0 0 504 565 v-5" fill="none"/>
</g>
</g>
<!-- 7 nut -->
<g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.3">
  <path d="M388 776 L388 792 A12 4 0 0 0 412 792 L412 776" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="776" rx="12" ry="4" fill="#dde"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="776" rx="4" ry="1.5" fill="#222"/>
  <path d="M396 792 v10 h8 v-10" fill="url(#steel)"/>
</g>

<!-- 8 beaker -->
<g stroke="#557" stroke-width="1.5">
  <path d="M312 850 L312 1110 A88 18 0 0 0 488 1110 L488 850" fill="url(#glass)"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="850" rx="88" ry="18" fill="#e8f4fa" fill-opacity=".6"/>
  <path d="M312 850 Q300 838 292 846 L312 862" fill="#e8f4fa" fill-opacity=".6"/>
  <path d="M312 1110 A88 18 0 0 1 488 1110" fill="none" stroke="#99a" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="880" x2="330" y2="1090" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="5" stroke-opacity=".8"/>
  <g stroke="#6a7a8a" stroke-width="1"><path d="M460 920h14M466 960h8M460 1000h14M466 1040h8"/></g>
</g>

<!-- 9 frame with handle -->
<g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5">
  <!-- rear straps visible through -->
  <path d="M300 1180 L300 1330" stroke="#888" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M500 1180 L500 1330" stroke="#888" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M300 1180 A100 18 0 0 1 500 1180" fill="none" stroke="#999" stroke-width="7"/>
  <path d="M300 1180 A100 18 0 0 0 500 1180" fill="none" stroke="url(#steel)" stroke-width="9"/>
  <path d="M300 1180 A100 18 0 0 0 500 1180" fill="none" stroke="#444" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- base cup -->
  <path d="M296 1318 L296 1340 A104 20 0 0 0 504 1340 L504 1318 Z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="1318" rx="104" ry="20" fill="#d6dade"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="1320" rx="92" ry="15" fill="#aeb4ba"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d="M330 1356 l-8 14 h20 l2 -10 M470 1356 l8 14 h-20 l-2 -10" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <!-- front strap -->
  <rect x="395" y="1196" width="10" height="138" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d="M500 1190 C590 1190 600 1210 600 1260 C600 1300 580 1310 500 1310 L500 1290 C560 1290 575 1285 575 1255 C575 1220 565 1212 500 1212 Z" fill="url(#black)"/>
</g>

<!-- labels -->
<g font-size="15" fill="#222" stroke="none">
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1" fill="none" marker-start="url(#dot)">
    <path d="M420 104 L560 104"/>
    <path d="M404 260 L560 260"/>
    <path d="M404 385 L560 385"/>
    <path d="M490 470 L560 470"/>
    <path d="M505 713 L560 698"/>
    <path d="M296 720 L240 720"/>
    <path d="M500 640 L560 640"/>
    <path d="M490 562 L560 562"/>
    <path d="M412 790 L560 790"/>
    <path d="M480 970 L560 970"/>
    <path d="M296 848 L240 848"/>
    <path d="M598 1250 L640 1250"/>
    <path d="M300 1250 L240 1250"/>
    <path d="M296 1335 L240 1335"/>
  </g>
  <text x="566" y="109">1. Knob</text>
  <text x="566" y="265">2. Plunger rod</text>
  <text x="566" y="390" font-size="13" fill="#555">threaded end</text>
  <text x="566" y="475">3. Lid (with pour slot)</text>
  <text x="566" y="693">6. Spiral plate</text>
  <text x="566" y="710" font-size="12" fill="#555">spring-coil rim seals to glass</text>
  <text x="234" y="725" text-anchor="end" font-size="13" fill="#555">spring rim</text>
  <text x="566" y="645">5. Mesh filter screen</text>
  <text x="566" y="565">4. Cross plate</text>
  <text x="566" y="795">7. Retaining nut</text>
  <text x="566" y="975">8. Glass beaker</text>
  <text x="234" y="853" text-anchor="end" font-size="13" fill="#555">spout</text>
  <text x="646" y="1255">9. Handle</text>
  <text x="234" y="1255" text-anchor="end">10. Frame</text>
  <text x="234" y="1340" text-anchor="end">11. Base / feet</text>
</g>
<text text-anchor="end" x="172" y="760" font-size="13" fill="#555">Filter assembly</text>
<text text-anchor="end" x="172" y="776" font-size="13" fill="#555">(parts 4–6, clamped</text>
<text text-anchor="end" x="172" y="792" font-size="13" fill="#555">by nut 7 on rod thread)</text>
<path d="M190 540 L180 540 L180 800 L190 800" fill="none" stroke="#777"/>
</svg>
